blurb: Creative Edge Studio offers dance classes including ballet, jazz, hip-hop, tap, tumbling, and acting for various ages and skill levels. They provide a structured environment with a dress code and attendance policies to support dancer development. The studio also hosts children's parties with dance and tumble activities, games, and themed decorations.
extraNote: Registration accepted on first come, first served basis with payment and form · Make-up classes allowed within the semester for missed classes, no refunds or credits · Students must be picked up within 5 minutes of class end · No photography or videotaping without permission
